name: Past Efforts in Warsong Gulch
summary: Past Efforts in Warsong Gulch is a military commendation turned in to capital city officers in recognition of service on the front lines. Rather than celebrating outright conquest, it honors veterans who offered valiant struggle and sacrifice amidst the contested woods of Ashenvale. City commanders accept these tokens to sustain war morale and reward dedication across both factions.

sections.title: Honoring the Fallen and the Valiant
sections.body: War between the Silverwing Sentinels and the Warsong Outriders rarely yields clean or effortless victories. Across the southern borders of Ashenvale, skirmishes are brutal, bloody, and often end without decisive triumph. Recognizing that morale cannot hinge entirely on unblemished success, commanders in Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and other capitals instituted honors for steadfast service. The Ribbon of Sacrifice commemorates those who threw themselves into the fray regardless of the odds.

sections.title: The War Effort at Home
sections.body: Capital officials such as the Alliance Brigadier Generals and Horde Warbringers manage mobilization far behind the front lines. While recruiters direct new blood toward battlefields like Warsong Gulch, quartermasters and tacticians must account for returning fighters who endured grueling campaigns. By acknowledging individual courage and sacrifices in stalemate or defeat, leadership ensures that frontline soldiers remain committed to holding Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this commendation?
faq.answer: The commendation acknowledges frontline combatants who gave everything during engagements in Warsong Gulch. Capital commanders accept proof of heroic struggle to reward perseverance and sustain war morale across the realm.

faq.q: Who accepts these tokens of sacrifice?
aliases: where to turn in past efforts
faq.answer: Senior military liaisons stationed in major cities accept them, including Alliance Brigadier Generals in places like Stormwind and Horde Warbringers in cities like Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does the military reward efforts that did not lead to victory?
faq.answer: Commanders understand that relentless combat in the forests of Ashenvale exacts a steep toll. Rewarding dedication and grit reminds combatants that their blood and sacrifice are valued even when the battle outcome falls short of total victory.

faq.q: Where does the conflict of Warsong Gulch take place?
faq.answer: Warsong Gulch lies along the southern border of Ashenvale, where the orcish Warsong Outriders gather lumber while clashing against the fierce resistance of the night elf Silverwing Sentinels.

faq.q: Can members of both the Alliance and Horde undertake this?
faq.answer: Yes. Both factions maintain equivalent military leaderships in their respective capitals to honor the soldiers returning from the bloody logging skirmishes in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What does the Ribbon of Sacrifice represent?
faq.answer: The Ribbon of Sacrifice is an emblem bestowed upon or carried by combatants who endured fierce clashes in Warsong Gulch, testifying to their unwavering willingness to fight on behalf of their people.

angles.text: For Alliance forces, turning in ribbons to the Brigadier General reaffirms their pledge to defend the ancient forests and support their night elven allies against Warsong aggression.
For the Horde, delivering tokens to city Warbringers proves that the blood spilled securing wood and survival in Ashenvale was not offered in vain.
Frontline combatants who weathered the brutal melee in the gulch understand better than anyone that true discipline lies in fighting fiercely even when victory hangs in the balance.
